basics.name: Ruotolo Vincenzo
basics.label: Software engineer
basics.summary: Versatile Software Engineer with strong experience in robotics systems, backend development, and telemetry/data pipelines. Deep expertise in C++ and Python applied to real-time control, autonomous systems, scalable cloud backends, and ETL pipelines for vehicle telemetry and test data. Secondary strengths in embedded systems, ML/AI, and automated testing. Proven track record delivering production- grade software for automotive ADAS, cloud-native APIs, and robotic platforms.

work.name: Autonomous Robotic Systems
work.summary: Designed a scalable, modular robotics architecture for multi-platform autonomy (UGV / UAV / UUV) prioritizing component reuse, versioned interfaces and safe upgrade paths.
highlights: Develop and deploy core algorithm modules (SLAM, GNC and Sensors) in C++/ROS2
Implement embedded firmware, hardware drivers and system integration
Lead and coordinate a cross-functional agile team of 8 engineers

work.name: Luxoft (DXC)
work.summary: Engineered Python-based automation testing framework for Ford’s BlueCruise (ADAS L2+), boosting validation coverage and reducing testing time.
highlights: Built a Python automation & telemetry pipeline for BlueCruise (ADAS L2+), combining pytest orchestration with ETL to ingest, normalize and replay vehicle telemetry for deterministic HIL validation
Implemented CAN / UDS / TCP / UDP adapters for trace capture, injection and end-to-end replay
Developed unit/integration/smoke/sanity suites and Python harnesses that shifted many checks off HIL into CI, reducing regression time

work.name: Luxoft (DXC)
work.summary: C++ software developer for Adaptive AUTOSAR application layer.
highlights: Implemented C++ modules for Adaptive AUTOSAR (ARA::COM); designed efficient serialization/deserialization for ECU data flows
Created C++ unit/integration tests and Python bindings for automated validation
Enforced MISRA-inspired coding practices and static analysis in CI

work.name: Cosmico
work.summary: Built a cloud-native backend for automated technical interview evaluation using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy, implementing candidate management, pre-formed assessments and result aggregation.
highlights: Built cloud-native backend (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy) for automated interview evaluation; implemented candidate management and assessment orchestration

Implemented ETL pipelines to ingest candidate submissions (code, logs, recordings), normalize and persist artifacts (S3), and produce queryable datasets for analytics and recruiter dashboards, processing 1,500+ assessments per month with 98% uptime
Integrated ML/AI inference for automated scoring (code quality, tests, plagiarism detection) and designed retraining pipelines using labeled outcomes and feedback loops

volunteer.summary: Lead organizer for the New York City branch of the People's Climate March, the largest climate march in history.
highlights: Awarded 'Climate Hero' award by Greenpeace for my efforts organizing the march.
Men of the year 2014 by Time magazine

projects.name: DRAFT PoliTO | European Space Agency - Space Resources Challenge
projects.summary: Challenge aiming to develop an autonomous system of UGV and UAV, collaborating in a unknown space environment. Led the robotics architecture, core module development, integration, and DevOps.
highlights: Design high-level robotics architectures with ROS2
Develop navigation and control applications
Led DevOps initiatives

projects.name: DRAFT PoliTO | Leonardo Drone Contest
projects.summary: Contest aims to develop autonomous drones in contest of GPS-denied condition. Designed the high-level robotics architecture, led component integration and simulation
highlights: Design high-level robotics architectures with ROS
Created and validated robotics simulations in Gazebo
Software and hardware integration

courses: Thesis: Optimal Trajectory Generation via MPC for a Four-Wheel Steering UGV
